headline: Executive order creates a White House council focused on homeland security partnerships.
what_it_does: This order sets up a new group inside the White House called the Homeland Security Partnership Council. Based on its title, the council is meant to support partnerships on homeland security issues. No summary was provided, so details about its members, duties, or the groups it works with are not described here.

who_it_affects.group: Federal agencies and White House staff
who_it_affects.how: They would take part in or support the new council, though the specific roles are not described in the available information.

when_it_takes_effect: Signed October 26, 2012; no separate effective date was provided.
